beats.description: Juliana grinds herbs by candlelight beside her open herbal grimoire at the cottage table.
Frantic pounding at the door; Juliana looks up in alarm and Alexander opens the door into the rain.
A soaked, distraught peasant mother enters carrying her feverish child and asks for the herbal woman.
Juliana lays the boy on the table, checks his fever and breathing, and asks how long he has been ill; the mother says since yesterday morning.
Juliana consults the grimoire, identifies Feverfew and states the remedy needs chamomile and willow bark.
Alexander questions her certainty; Juliana answers with resolute conviction.
Juliana gathers herbs and asks for hot water; Alexander fetches a kettle and pours water into the mortar as the mother pleads.
Juliana comforts the mother and gives the boy the herbal brew; he swallows and coughs weakly.
The mother despairs that the remedy is not working; Juliana asks her to wait while monitoring the pulse.
The boy's breathing deepens and sweat forms on his forehead; the mother says the fever is breaking.
Juliana exhales with relief; the mother thanks her and Juliana modestly credits the herbs and asks that the boy rest.
The mother leaves into the rain, vowing the village will remember Juliana; Alexander shuts the door.
Alexander warns that gossip about Juliana may spread; Juliana defiantly values the child's life over gossip, and Alexander cautions that gossip can become dangerous.
Juliana steps in front of Alexander and says they will face the consequences together.
In the lord's study, the Blond Nobleman reads by the fire as the soaked Former Groom enters and halts behind his chair.
The Former Groom reports a rumor about a war veteran who may resemble the late Duke.
The Blond Nobleman dismisses the rumor as ghost stories; after the Former Groom describes a Duke-like scar, he turns sharply and demands where.
The Former Groom says no one is certain of the location; the Blond Nobleman masks his panic with disdain and the Former Groom leaves.
Alone, the Blond Nobleman whispers 'Impossible' and stares into the fire in mounting dread until the screen cuts to black.
